description: This file defines a Java interface 'PayloadMapping' that specifies methods related to handling payload mappings in a connectivity model within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods to retrieve mappings and check if the mappings are empty.

classes.name: PayloadMapping
classes.description: An interface representing a collection of payload mappings, providing methods to retrieve mappings and check if the mapping set is empty.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the list of payload mapping strings to be applied for messages.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the payload mappings are empty (no mappings defined).
